name: Inbou no Wakusei ~Hakai to Yokubou no Shoudou~
original_name: 淫暴の惑星～破壊と欲望の衝動～
source:
Shin lost his parents when he was a kid and his uncle has taken care of him since then. Shin is a good-natured boy, but he is sometimes confused by destruction impulse.... "I wanna destroy everything...." One day, when he is dating with Mina, his friend, they are taken hostage by someone. By being confined in a small room full of madness and violence, his pent-up desire finally explodes....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081217034015/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011575]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
真幼年时失去双亲，此后一直由叔父照顾。他本性善良，却时常被破坏冲动困扰…“我想毁掉一切…”一天，他与朋友美奈约会时遭人劫持。在充斥疯狂与暴力的狭小房间中遭到囚禁后，他压抑已久的欲望终于爆发…
